row_granularity: One claim or claimant/payee line; an occurrence may contain multiple claimant/payee lines.
notes: The main table header repeats on page 2. Rows may continue across multiple lines with Policy, Policy Effect, Named Insured, Oc #, and Loss Date blank on continuation lines. The End Rsv or Month Closed column contains either a numeric end reserve or a month/year closed value. Subtotal rows follow loss dates and policy effective dates; the report also includes policy symbol and report grand total rows.
